_comment: Regression for #539: #402's real comment shape -- no **Run:** marker (empty baseline, every comment counts) and a long OWNER analysis whose prose says 'it should stop retrying and finish'. The word 'stop' in prose is not a stop command.

comments.body:
## First live occurrence after spec 052: implement cycle 1 of spec 056

[Run 35486482556](https://github.com/charlesguse/wing-commander/actions/runs/35486482556), `implement.yml` cycle arm, `claude-sonnet-5`, dispatched 03:24:25 UTC on 2026-09-20. The App token for the spec-branch remote was minted at job start, so it expired at about 04:24.

**What the agent saw** (from the `claude-execution-output-cycle` artifact, 2,741 events):

| time | event |
|---|---|
| 03:29 → 04:23 | 12 pushes succeed; last successful push is `477ff50` at 04:23:13 |
| 04:36 | commit `20fc43e` (gate-suite fix); `git push` fails: `remote: Invalid username or token. Password authentication is not supported for Git operations. fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/charlesguse/wing-commander.git/'` |
| 04:36 → 04:52 | the agent keeps working and committing (`785d59e`, `faa57ce`, `26eec56`, `04a5a80`, `8215420`) and retries the push **ten more times**, every one with the same error, the last three described as "Final push attempt", "One more push retry", "Final push attempt before wrapping up" |
| 04:52 | the agent ends with six commits unpushed; the cycle is classified over budget (446 of 180 intended turns) |
| 04:55 | spec 052's `Refresh authenticated spec-branch remote (post-agent, cycle)` step re-mints, and the six stranded commits reach `spec/056-stage-found-defect-filing` |

**Outcome this time:** nothing lost. The post-agent refresh from spec 052 (FR-007) recovered the stranded work, the retry arm ran at the escalation model, and the cycle converged. So the residual risk FR-008 named is real and the recovery path holds.

**Cost it still carries:** the agent spent a measurable share of its 446 turns retrying a push that could not succeed, and it had no way to tell an expired token from a transient failure. A cycle that hits the runaway ceiling (450) while pushes are failing would end with its final commits recoverable only if the post-agent refresh step still runs. A cycle whose agent step is killed or cancelled would not get there.

Two shapes this evidence supports for the fix: tell the agent, in the prompt or a tool-result hint, that an `Authentication failed` on push after roughly an hour is the credential lifetime and it should stop retrying and finish; or bound the agent step's wall clock below the token lifetime so the case cannot arise. Both stay the owner's call, per the issue's original framing.
